content.text: The shell refused the loop, so I'll read the batch files directly.

I checked the learner's rule against all eight weekly batches before writing anything. It holds up, but I have not imported it yet, because GND needs an audit actor and request time first.

**Coverage check**, read from the batch files. The rule is `wrong(A) :- refund_amount(A, _, V), V > 500`. I read "every week" as every batch.

| Store | Amounts | Rule fires? | Auditor's label | Agrees? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| north | 40, 120, 75 | no | clean | yes |
| south | 500, 60, 230 | no (500 is not over 500) | clean | yes |
| east | 310, 90 | no | clean | yes |
| west | 450, 35, 180 | no | clean | yes |
| harbor | 1200 | yes | flagged | yes |
| market | 750 | yes | flagged | yes |
| airport | 1500 | yes | flagged | yes |
| station | 640 | yes | flagged | yes |

The rule covers exactly {harbor, market, airport, station}, which matches the learner's run record. That is my own reading of the YAML, not GND's check. GND's check is `gnd import ilp-rules`, which re-runs every clause over every labelled batch and writes the proposal only if the coverage matches.

Two things for the reviewer. The learned threshold of 500 is stricter than the written rule of 1000, which is the point of the example. And the 500 comes from host data, so the candidate carries host values.

**Needed from you before I run the import:**
1. **Who should the proposal be recorded as?** This becomes the audit actor. I won't take a name from git or the environment.
2. **At what time?** An ISO-8601 timestamp with a UTC offset, for example `2026-11-26T09:00:00+00:00`.

Once you answer, I'll run this from the working folder, writing a new proposal file (I'd suggest `refunds-limit.proposal.json`, which does not exist yet):

```sh
gnd import ilp-rules model.orm.yaml learned/learned.clauses.json --labels labels.json --reported-coverage learned/learned.run.json --target neutral --out refunds-limit.proposal.json --actor <ACTOR> --requested-at <TIMESTAMP>
```

If you'd rather a different output name, tell me. After the import exits 0, I'll hand the proposal to gnd-model-evolve for review. I won't apply it.
